axioms: A derived view cannot supersede canonical records.
Source, provenance, and legacy unknowns are not invented.
Migrating to PES-15 does not modify the PES-14 original or its consumers.
Proposals are distinct from decisions; code changes are distinct from runtime verification.
Unknown and stale information cannot be represented as verified live truth.
Canonical snapshots are never silently compacted or overwritten.
Classification, prioritization, implementation, verification and acceptance are independent per-task phases.
A finished prioritization phase never implies implemented, verified, accepted or closed work.
A task is deliverable-complete only for its explicitly declared deliverable_phase, not on account of its rank or color.
Implementation completed means the change/output was produced; it is not evidence of passed tests or owner approval.
Migrated tasks with no phase data remain workflow-unknown; historic status or implementation_state must not be reinterpreted as phase evidence.
Verification passed requires an explicit Verification record; owner acceptance requires an explicit Acceptance record.
A task-phase update must change only the requested phase and cannot silently advance other phases.
task_delivery_policy: task deliverable completion is evaluated from workflow.deliverable_phase only; status is a legacy descriptive field, never an implicit state machine
